say:1:1737202801:1.text: Don't ask. I just wanted a higher vantage point to look at these paths, but I lost my footing.
say:1:1737202801:1.source_cn: 别提了，我就是想爬高点看看这些小路的全貌，没想到一个没...

say:1:1737202801:1.female: Don't ask. I just wanted a higher vantage point to look at these paths, but I lost my footing.

say:2:1737202802:1.text: Wait. Dura above... Are you Magister Merlin?!
say:2:1737202802:1.source_cn: ——等等等等！艾雅在上，您、您——您不是梅林阁下吗？！

say:4:1737202803:1.text: Uh... ahem... Magister, apologies for you seeing me in such a state... I mean, there's a perfectly logical explanation for this!

say:5:1737202804:1.text: We're planning to redraw the local maps, and this rock... this rock is a great reference point!
say:5:1737202804:1.source_cn: 我们打算重新规划一下这附近的道路，而这块石头……这块石...

say:9:1737202807:1.source_cn: 万一有前来狩猎的贵客被卡在石头里怎么办？我决定以身涉险...

say:11:1737202808:1.text: Y-yes, that's right! I simply wanted to... see the world from a different angle!

narration:14:1737202810:0.text: You sigh, stop listening to the guard's flimsy excuses, and pull him out from between the rocks.
narration:14:1737202810:0.source_cn: 你叹了口气，不再听守备军欲盖弥彰的解释，将他从石缝中拉起……

say:15:1737202811:1.text: Thank the Goddess... I'm finally out! Ugh, my back...
say:15:1737202811:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，总算出来了……我的腰……<key:dialog1>
say:15:1737202811:1.male: Thank the Goddess... I'm finally out! Ugh, my back...
say:15:1737202811:1.female: Thank the Goddess... I'm finally out! Ugh, my back...

choice:17:1:2.text: That kind of "different angle" won't do you any good.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 别再从这个视角看世界了
choice:17:1:2.male: That kind of "different angle" won't do you any good.
choice:17:1:2.female: That kind of "different angle" won't do you any good.

say:23:1737202815:1.text: I'm so sorry! I lied! I just slipped and got myself stuck in this crack...
say:23:1737202815:1.source_cn: 十分抱歉！梅林阁下，我对您说了谎……我、我就是不小心滑...

choice:28:1:2.female: Try not to get stuck again.
